I'm using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

The caller passed resolved PR values, so I follow `reference/pr-head.md` instead of Steps 0 and 1.

## Resolve root and home

1. cwd `/private/var/folders/.../eval-skill-fxO21G`: `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir`. Both paths are the same.
   - `ROOT=/work/widget`
2. `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree` returns empty, so this is not a submodule.
3. Admitted values:
   - **Home:** #12 `fix/retry`, `PRE_REWORK_HEAD=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
   - **MEMBER_HEADS:**
     - #13 `fix/cap` `bbbb…bbbb`
     - #14 `fix/retry-docs` `cccc…cccc`
4. There is no wrapper, no overrides `create:`/`home:` and no native tool.
   - `NAME=fix-retry`
   - `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`

## Fetch and stops (before any write)

5. `git -C /work/widget fetch origin` succeeds.
6. Reachability and remote equality, per PR:
   - `git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q aaaa…aaaa^{commit}` passes, and `git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry` equals `aaaa…`.
   - The same checks for `bbbb…` against `origin/fix/cap` and for `cccc…` against `origin/fix/retry-docs` pass.
7. `BASE_SHA=$(git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main)` gives `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`.
8. Ordered stops:
   - `isCrossRepository` is false for every PR.
   - `git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain` does not list `fix/retry`.
   - Reachability already passed.
   - The local-branch ancestry row applies only when N=1.
9. Recovery check: `git -C /work/widget show-ref --verify refs/heads/fix/retry` finds no local branch, and no home worktree exists. There is nothing to recover.

## Provision

10. Clean base: `git -C /work/widget status --porcelain` exits 0 with empty output, so the base is clean.
11. The home is inside the primary. `git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees` exits 0, so `.worktrees` is already ignored and nothing is committed.
12. Provenance: `git -C /work/widget symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD` returns empty, so resolution fails and I skip the note silently.
13. No worktree and no local branch exist, so I use unique-remote DWIM: `git -C /work/widget worktree add "/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry" fix/retry`.
14. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD` returns `aaaa…aaaa`, which equals the #12 `headRefOid`.

## Member merges

15. Saved last-good is `aaaa…aaaa`.
    - Run `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff -m "merge PR #13 head bbbbbbb into PR #12" bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`.
    - It merges cleanly. Record: `Member merge: #13 eeeeeee`.
16. Saved last-good is now `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`.
    - Run `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff -m "merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12" cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`.
    - It conflicts.
17. Pre-helper snapshot: `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain` shows both files as UU.
18. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` lists `src/retry.ts` and `test/retry.test.mjs`.
19. Runner source: `git -C /work/widget show dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd:.pi/gauntlet-overrides.md`, the first-found ladder file.
    - `## PR gate` documents `node --test <files>` with `requires credentials: false`.
    - `SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS = node --test test/retry.test.mjs`

## Helper dispatch

20. I dispatch one fresh foreground `implementer` with `cwd: "/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry"` and `async: false`. Its instructions:
    - Resolve exactly `src/retry.ts` and `test/retry.test.mjs`, preserving the intent of both the #12 side (with #13 merged) and the #14 side. These are retry-cap changes.
    - Run exactly `node --test test/retry.test.mjs`.
    - Run `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry add` on each resolved file.
    - Return `done`, or `done - contract exception: <why>` if the resolution changes a PR or bound-ticket obligation.
    - Do not commit, do not abort, and do not edit any file outside the list.

## Completion check

21. The helper returns `done`.
22. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` returns `src/retry.ts`. The unmerged index is not empty, so completion fails.
    - I do not run `git commit --no-edit`.

## Abort and restoration checks

23. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --abort` exits 0.
24. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD` returns `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`, matching saved last-good.
25. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry branch --show-current` returns `fix/retry`.
26. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` succeeds with empty output.

All checks pass, so the worktree is restored.

**STOP:**
`PR #14 conflicts with home PR #12 in src/retry.ts, test/retry.test.mjs; the worktree at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry is left on fix/retry at eeeeeee with #13 already merged; merge #14 by hand there (git merge --no-ff cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc) and rerun the same list, or rerun without #14.`

If you merge by hand, keep the subject `merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12` so a rerun recognizes it.

There is no `origin/main` merge, no later members, no ready Step 4 report, no thread fetch or gather, no spec, no plan, no push and no close. Provenance carried for the rerun:
- `Pre-rework head: aaaa…` (#12), `bbbb…` (#13) and `cccc…` (#14)
- `Member merge: #13 eeeeeee`
- `Base SHA: ddddddd`

---

## Residual-edit checkpoint

20′. The helper returns `done` but also modified `README.md`.

21′. Completion check:
- `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U` and `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain` show a status delta that includes `README.md`.
- `README.md` is outside the listed paths, so completion fails and there is no commit.

22′. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --abort` exits 0.

23′. Post-abort checks:
- `rev-parse HEAD` returns `eeee…eeee`, which matches.
- `branch --show-current` returns `fix/retry`, which matches.
- `status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` returns ` M README.md`. This is a residual edit, so the check fails.

**STOP (actual state, not restored):**
- Failing PR: #14
- Conflicted files: `src/retry.ts`, `test/retry.test.mjs`
- Worktree: `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`
- Observed branch: `fix/retry`
- Observed HEAD: `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`
- Abort exit status: 0
- Remaining status path: ` M README.md`
- Saved last-good: `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`, with #13 already merged

Manual recovery of `README.md` is required before rerunning. I do not claim the checkout or index is restored, and I run no reset, clean or checkout.

There is no base merge and no downstream continuation.

---

## Failed-abort checkpoint

22″. `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --abort` exits 1 with its error.

23″. Post-abort checks:
- `rev-parse HEAD` returns `eeee…eeee`.
- `branch --show-current` returns `fix/retry`.
- `status --porcelain --untracked-files=all` returns `UU src/retry.ts`.

The abort exit status and the status output both fail the checks.

**STOP (actual state, not restored):**
- Failing PR: #14
- Conflicted files: `src/retry.ts`, `test/retry.test.mjs`
- Worktree: `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`
- Observed branch: `fix/retry`
- Observed HEAD: `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`
- Abort exit status: 1, with the abort error reported verbatim
- Remaining status path: `UU src/retry.ts`
- Saved last-good: `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`, with #13 already merged

A merge is still in progress. Manual recovery is required before rerunning the same list. I do not use the restored-state message, and I do not reset or clean to force recovery.

There is no base merge, no member continuation, no spec, no plan, no push and no close.

I’m using the using-git-worktrees skill to set up an isolated workspace.

All commands below have process cwd `/work/widget`; `git -C` explicitly selects the checkout. These are synthetic observations, not tool executions. The two checkpoints replace the indicated failure outcome; neither is a continuation after a stop.

### 1. Resolve and preflight

Resolved:

- `ROOT=/work/widget`
- `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`
- `BRANCH=fix/retry`, `NAME=fix-retry`
- Home: `acme/widget#12`, original head `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`
- Members, in order: #13 at `bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb`, then #14 at `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`
- Base: `main`; all heads are in-repository.

Commands:

```sh
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-dir --git-common-dir
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --show-superproject-working-tree
```

Resolve the common directory to `/work/widget/.git`; this is the primary, not a submodule. The PR-head procedure applies instead of generic linked-worktree reuse.

Read the first-found overrides and checkout settings before discovery:

```sh
for f in .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md gauntlet-overrides.md doc/gauntlet-overrides.md; do
  if test -f "/work/widget/$f"; then cat "/work/widget/$f"; break; fi
done
if test -f /work/widget/.pi/settings.json; then cat /work/widget/.pi/settings.json; fi
for f in /work/widget/AGENTS.md; do
  if test -f "$f"; then cat "$f"; fi
done
ls -a /work/widget /work/widget/script /work/widget/bin
```

No worktree override, native creator, or wrapper applies. Resolve the default home to the supplied selected home.

```sh
git -C /work/widget fetch origin
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa^{commit}'
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q 'bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb^{commit}'
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/cap
git -C /work/widget rev-parse --verify -q 'cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc^{commit}'
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/fix/retry-docs
git -C /work/widget rev-parse origin/main
```

All original objects exist; each remote equals its original head. Resolve:

```text
PRE_REWORK_HEAD=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
BASE_SHA=dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd
```

```sh
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget show-ref --verify refs/heads/fix/retry
test -e /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry
git -C /work/widget status --porcelain
git -C /work/widget check-ignore -q .worktrees
```

No branch/path collision or recovery state exists. Source is clean; `.worktrees` is ignored. No ignore-file write is needed.

### 2. Provision and verify

Setting up the isolated worktree at `/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry` on existing PR branch `fix/retry`.

```sh
git -C /work/widget worktree add /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry fix/retry
git -C /work/widget worktree list --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry branch --show-current
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
```

Unique-remote DWIM creates the tracking checkout. The registered path matches, branch is `fix/retry`, and HEAD equals the full original home head.

### 3. Merge members

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff -m "merge PR #13 head bbbbbbb into PR #12" bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
```

Member merge: #13 `eeeeeee`. Save last-good SHA `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`.

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --no-ff -m "merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12" cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
```

Conflicts: `src/retry.ts`, `test/retry.test.mjs`.

Read the first-found overrides from the fetched base, not the conflicted checkout:

```sh
for p in .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md gauntlet-overrides.md doc/gauntlet-overrides.md; do
  if content=$(git -C /work/widget show "dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd:$p"); then
    printf '%s\n' "$content"
    break
  fi
done
```

The documented PR-gate runner is `node --test <files>`, credentials false. Resolve `SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS=node --test test/retry.test.mjs`.

Dispatch one fresh foreground implementer, `cwd=/work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry`, `async=false`, instructed:

> Resolve only `src/retry.ts` and `test/retry.test.mjs`, preserving both sides’ intent against fetched base `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`. Run exactly `node --test test/retry.test.mjs`. Stage each resolved file with `git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry add`. Do not commit, abort, or edit other paths. Return `done`, or `done - contract exception: <why>`.

Helper returns `done`. Completion checks:

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --name-only --diff-filter=U
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry diff --cached --name-only
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain
```

An unmerged path remains. Completion fails; no commit.

```sh
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry merge --abort
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry rev-parse HEAD
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry branch --show-current
git -C /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry status --porcelain --untracked-files=all
```

Abort exits 0; HEAD equals saved last-good SHA, branch matches, status is empty.

**Stop:** PR #14 conflicts with home PR #12 in src/retry.ts, test/retry.test.mjs; the worktree at /work/widget/.worktrees/fix-retry is left on fix/retry at eeeeeee with #13 already merged; merge #14 by hand there (`git merge --no-ff cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`) and rerun the same list, or rerun without #14.

Retain canonical subject `merge PR #14 head ccccccc into PR #12`.

### Residual-edit checkpoint

Same completion/abort/check commands. Helper also edits `README.md`; containment fails. Abort exits 0; HEAD and branch match, but status is:

```text
 M README.md
```

Stop: #14 resolution failed in the two conflict files; selected worktree remains on `fix/retry` at saved SHA `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`, with #13 merged and residual `README.md` modification. Manual recovery is required before rerunning. Checkout/index restoration is **not** established.

### Failed-abort checkpoint

Same commands; abort exits 1 with an error. HEAD and branch match saved state; status is:

```text
UU src/retry.ts
```

Stop: #14 resolution and abort failed at the selected worktree; abort error reported, exit 1. Observed branch `fix/retry`, HEAD `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`; #13 remains merged, `src/retry.ts` remains unmerged. Manual recovery required.

No reset, clean, restored-state claim, Step 4 ready report, base merge, or downstream continuation occurs.
